body.name: two-parent windmill gadget
body.construction: For \(\ell\ge3\), \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) has vertex set \(V_{2\ell}\), directed edges \(i\to i+1\) for \(1\le i<2\ell\) and \(i\to i+2\) for \(1\le i\le2\ell-2\), and every bidirected edge except \[\{\{i,i+1\}:2\le i\le\ell\}\cup\{\{\ell+1,2\}\}\cup\{\{i,i+1\}:\ell+1\le i\le2\ell-1\}\cup\{\{2\ell,\ell+1\}\}.\] Thus the missing-bidirected graph on the nonroot vertices consists of two \(\ell\)-cycles meeting only at vertex \(\ell+1\), and the directed indegree equals two from vertex \(3\) onward.
